# Metro Auto Detailing

> Fully mobile auto detailing in Bakersfield, CA. We come to you — home, office, or wherever the vehicle is parked. No drop-off. No shop.

## About

Metro Auto Detailing is a solo mobile operation in Bakersfield, CA. Every job is done by the owner. We bring everything: water, generator, pressure washer, all chemicals and equipment. You don't need to provide anything or be present.

We are not a car wash. A car wash runs a vehicle through a machine and rinses it. A detail uses decontamination products, professional-grade chemicals, and hand processes a machine cannot replicate. The difference is visible in the paint, not just on the surface.

Appointment only. No walk-ins. No fixed location.

## Services

Prices are Sedan/Coupe. 5-Seat SUV/Truck and 7-Seat SUV/Van cost more per service — see pricing table below.

### Exterior Refresh — $80 / $100 / $120
Full exterior wash finished with a spray wax for shine, upgradeable to a 3-month ceramic sealant for $30. Wheels, tires, and rims cleaned, tire dressing, door jambs and windows cleaned. The entry tier below Signature Detail — no decontamination.

### Signature Detail — $150 / $180 / $210
Full wash and a 3-month ceramic sealant outside, full interior blowout and vacuum inside, all interior panels and console cleaned, door jambs and windows cleaned. Built for a vehicle that's already maintained. No decontamination.

### Clay n Seal — $150 / $180 / $210
Full exterior decontamination finished with a 6-month ceramic sealant (the decontamination lets the sealant bond longer). Iron decontamination dissolves bonded metallic contamination. Clay bar treatment removes remaining surface contamination and leaves paint smooth to the touch. The only package with decontamination.

### Interior Detail — $200 / $230 / $260
Full interior reset. Thorough vacuum, all panels and surfaces cleaned, carpet and seat shampoo with extraction, UV interior protectant, interior windows cleaned, door jambs cleaned.

### Full Detail — $350 / $380 / $410
Full exterior wash and a 3-month ceramic sealant outside, complete interior reset inside. Full interior vacuum, all surfaces and panels cleaned, carpet and seat shampoo with extraction, UV interior protectant, windows inside and out, door jambs. Does not include decontamination — Clay n Seal can be added separately.

- Oversized (duallys, sprinter vans) — quoted separately, not on the published price ladder

## Add-Ons

- Headlight Restoration: $100 — lenses sanded progressively, polished, prepped with IPA, coated with ceramic clear coat. Restores clarity and protects against UV yellowing.
- Trim Restoration: $100 — Solution Finish applied to faded black plastic trim. Semi-permanent bond to the plastic, not a dressing that washes off. Lasts 9-12+ months.
- Water Spot Removal: $50 — acid wash breaks down mineral deposits etched into paint and glass from hard water exposure.
- Pet Hair and Sand Removal: $50 — full extraction of embedded pet hair and sand from carpet and seats.
- Engine Bay Detail: $50 — degreased, cleaned, and dressed.
- Leather Conditioning: $50 — leather cleaned, conditioned, and protected against drying and cracking.

## Maintenance Plans

Plans start after your first service and maintain that same service on a schedule you choose. The scope stays whatever you first got. An Exterior Refresh stays exterior, a Signature stays Signature. Price follows how often we come out, because that sets how much the car builds up between visits. The more often, the less each visit costs. No contracts, cancel anytime. Prices are Sedan/Coupe / 5-Seat SUV/Truck / 7-Seat SUV/Van.

- Every 2 Weeks: $90 / $120 / $150. Light touch-up, the car hasn't had time to get dirty.
- Monthly: $110 / $140 / $170. A few weeks of dust and daily driving, brought back to clean.
- Bi-Monthly (every 2 months): $150 / $180 / $210. Two months of buildup, so each visit does a little more.
- Quarterly: $190 / $220 / $250. Three months of buildup, the deepest visit. Heavily soiled vehicles may take an on-site upcharge.
- Exterior Refresh plans: matched to the one-time rate, $80 / $100 / $120, on any schedule.

## Common Questions

**What do I need to provide?**
Nothing. We bring water, generator, all equipment and products.

**Do I need to be home?**
No. Leave the car accessible and keys available.

**What areas do you serve?**
Bakersfield, CA and surrounding areas within 15 miles. Southwest Bakersfield, Stockdale, Seven Oaks, Terra Vista, Rosedale, Northwest Bakersfield, and nearby communities.

**Why do Bakersfield vehicles need decontamination services?**
Bakersfield has some of the worst air quality in the country. Agricultural dust, industrial fallout, and brake dust bond to paint over time. The heat accelerates oxidation. Hard water leaves mineral deposits on paint and glass that a standard wash cannot remove. Iron remover and acid wash break down that contamination. A wash maintains a clean car. A decontamination service removes what a wash leaves behind.

**How long does a detail take?**
Signature Detail: ~1 hour. Full Detail: 4-6+ hours. Time depends on vehicle size and condition.

**What payment methods do you accept?**
All major credit and debit cards, cash, Zelle, Apple Pay.

**Is a deposit required?**
Yes. $30 deposit secures the appointment. Applied toward the total. Refundable with enough notice.
